mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_account_balance (accounting_date, subject_code, account_no, currency, balance_direction, begin_balance, debit_amount, credit_amount, end_balance, create_time, update_time, is_delete, tenant_id) VALUES
(#{item.accountingDate}, #{item.subjectCode}, #{item.accountNo}, #{item.currency}, #{item.balanceDirection.code}, #{item.beginBalance}, #{item.debitAmount}, #{item.creditAmount}, #{item.endBalance}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, COALESCE(#{item.tenantId}, -1))
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE begin_balance = VALUES(begin_balance), debit_amount = VALUES(debit_amount), credit_amount = VALUES(credit_amount), end_balance = VALUES(end_balance), balance_direction = VALUES(balance_direction), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT subject_code, SUM(end_balance) AS total_balance, SUM(debit_amount) AS total_debit, SUM(credit_amount) AS total_credit, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM t_account_balance WHERE accounting_date = #{accountingDate} AND is_delete = 0 GROUP BY subject_code
SELECT DISTINCT accounting_date FROM t_account_balance WHERE accounting_date <= #{endDate} AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY accounting_date ASC

SELECT id, accounting_date, subject_code, account_no, currency, balance_direction, begin_balance, debit_amount, credit_amount, end_balance, create_time, update_time, is_delete, tenant_id FROM t_account_balance WHERE subject_code = #{subjectCode} AND accounting_date = #{accountingDate} AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY account_no ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit_amount), 0) FROM t_account_balance WHERE accounting_date = #{accountingDate} AND is_delete = 0
